title: Provision of Internal Elevator at Kannur Lighthouse in Kochi Dte
summary: E-tender for providing an internal elevator (lift, including structural steel tower) at Kannur Lighthouse, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Provision of Internal Elevator at Kannur Lighthouse

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by post/hand by 07.04.2025 15:00. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Lift manufacturing agency with valid licence/registration from State CEIG or other licensing authority, with experience in fabrication and erection of structural steel tower for lift and lift installation; OR registered contractor in Joint Venture Consortium with lift manufacturer
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works

Similar work: supply, installation, testing and commissioning of elevator; for JV, civil engineering works (RCC tower, steel structures, multi-storeyed building, bridge, water tank) by first party plus lift manufacturer experience of second party; CEIG manufacturing licence of second party
A JV member may not bid individually or in another JV in the same tender
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified annual turnover of last three years
notes: Section-I NIT only; no BOQ or elevator specification. Bid query last date 24.03.2025 15:00; download/submission 18.03.2025 10:00 to 08.04.2025 15:00; technical opening subject to internet availability. Category chosen as heritage & tourism is uncertain; elevator appears intended for visitor access but document does not say so. See also nid 2096 (power supply/DG set for this elevator).
